His legacy extends beyond his military achievements, as he also patronized the arts and architecture, commissioning the construction of several churches and monasteries throughout Portugal.

Despite his significant contributions to Portuguese history, Jaques' life remains somewhat of a mystery, with many details lost to the passage of time.
